prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / brand palette adjustment.
Edit the attached approved Lucro Caseiro Google Play panoramic campaign, making a MINIMAL, REFINED BRAND-COLOR PASS. Preserve its light airy feeling. The user loves the composition and working character and wants the actual brand colors pink, wine, lime green expressed more clearly.
EXACT brand palette verified from app code: wine #4A2332, rose pink #B65F72, lime green #DCE86A, off-white #FAF8F6, soft pink #F5E5E8. Green is this yellowish LIME brand green, NOT sage, emerald, forest or mint for exterior design.
KEEP unchanged: the SAME woman, exact face and expression, tied brown hair, same posture and hands tying ribbon around cookie gift box, looking DOWN at her work, never camera. Same photographed cookies, box, tabletop, all positions, all headline/caption wording and font sizes, same FOUR equal-panel connected layout, EXACT 9:4 total aspect ratio. Same 3 app screenshots at same positions, keep app UI internal colors/content/text/numbers unchanged.
CHANGES only to OUTER DESIGN and clothing brand colors:
1. Preserve dominant warm off-white background #FAF8F6 and lots of empty space, keep subtle pink lower field #F5E5E8.
2. All large headlines become unmistakable dark WINE #4A2332. Small "Lucro Caseiro" wordmark and category lettering use muted brand ROSE #B65F72 rather than hot pink.
3. Put each of the three small category labels at top ("PRECIFICAÇÃO", "CATÁLOGO", "FINANCEIRO") inside a slim, understated rounded LIME #DCE86A tab, with WINE #4A2332 lettering. Tabs must hug labels, not huge banners; retain existing positions and lots of margins. Small accents only.
4. Change woman's sage-gray shirt to warm off-white cotton, and her oatmeal apron to solid rich WINE #4A2332 fabric, realistic matte linen texture, highlights and folds; same cut and fit. This is the principal wine color mass.
5. Keep the gift box natural kraft; make its bow and wrapping ribbon brand ROSE #B65F72. Add one small round LIME #DCE86A seal on the front of the box WITHOUT text. No other props.
6. Make the single connecting fine curve across entire panorama ROSE #B65F72. Add a narrow parallel lime #DCE86A stroke along short segments of that existing curve, subtle and harmonious, behind person and devices; no new big wave or bulky ribbon. Maintain seamless continuity across all four equal crop boundaries.
7. Keep device frames light ivory, maybe very fine rose border, no dark heavy hardware. No large dark backgrounds, no saturated green floods.
Visual hierarchy: 75% light space, 15% wine (apron and typography), 7% pink, 3% lime accents. Elegant, restrained, friendly and clearly recognizable brand colors. No stars, glitter, 3D decorations, extra text, extra people or new cards. Preserve original Portuguese wording and UI as accurately as possible, do not redesign interfaces. This is a color refinement of the approved campaign, not a new concept. Return ONE finished high-resolution panorama with same 9:4 ratio, four equal 9:16 sections; no outside border.
